text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond is running in the Japan Cup. As expected, Kitasan Black is here as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In addition, an Umamusume that Kitasan Black admires, Tokai Teio, is running as well. She also happens to be a rival of Mejiro McQueen's.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today, Satono Diamond and Kitasan Black are racing against Tokai Teio!
